card.name: Words that set up a modifying phrase
card.fires_on: Words right after a noun phrase that lead into a describing phrase, such as 'installed', 'arranged', 'with', 'have' and 'has'. The setting is technical or equipment descriptions, plus a few medical explanations.

modes.label: Participle after equipment noun
modes.description: A past-tense verb follows a device or tubing noun and begins a phrase saying how it is set up.
